scope: Repository navigation and offline SDK36 boot-definition/member inventory, plus source service/JNI review queues. Not an APK crash count or Android conformance score.
limits: Every baseline tracked path is mapped; source investigations are risk-directed, not a proof that every line or possible API behavior was exhaustively verified.

Fresh baseline and candidate app builds share reused core/framework artifacts from successful main run 43622672102, source revision 66f2077a25fc0066ba279dd8e99e5a7de39d7e50; full native/framework builds are separate CI gates.
Local app builds use pinned frameworks/base core/java source coverage for 136 generated compatibility change IDs, not a distributable full-source compatibility-change table.
Classes absent from boot may have module, shared-library, APK or annotation-only providers; those alternative providers are not resolved by this inventory.
Present descriptors do not prove JNI, ABI, permission, hardware or behavioral compatibility. Possible access-flag mismatches and descriptor dependencies require review.
7316 declarations belong to absent classes and are represented by the complete absent-class list and aggregate counts; full declaration rows remain reproducible with java_member_inventory.py.

Service source override matching compares method names only; signatures/arity are recorded without overload/type resolution. It is not a reachable call graph. Stand-in registrations can later be replaced by real registrations.
Historical native export lookup numbers are not relabeled as measurements of this candidate.
overlap_policy: No production paths overlap PR24, PR25 or PR26. Common ci.yml and track94 additions retain the other contracts. PR24 has newer Java path follow-up than the version included in PR25/26.
